item.title: What Kind of Leaders You Need
item.description:
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝗱𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱 : 𝗱𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿, 𝗖𝗼𝗮𝗰𝗵 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝗼𝗿 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿

I was reading about leadership where I came across different leadership styles. I got to know the nomenclature for leaders I worked with and the kind of leadership style I am following.

𝗗𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀 are the one who provide clear direction and instructions for execution. This style is particularly effective when leading teams that are new to the domain.

item.title: Startup: Change is the only constant
item.description:
𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗽: 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗼𝗻𝗹𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁

It’s human nature to get scared when there is change in the way we work. Be it the first day of school, first day in a new job, even when you get married, there’s always fear about how things will turn out in this new environment.

So this fear comes when you are willing to do something which you wanted to do. Now let’s think what if we are forced to change. Now there will be more frustration than fear as change is imposed on us and we are not in control.
